body:
The PR body now shows the Slot and Face Passes tabs before and after the change. I verified all four images from the fork’s `pr-screenshots` branch in the rendered PR.

I retargeted the PR to `main` before the parent branch is deleted. The source head remains `3572ca334`. I will wait for #3353 and #3387 to merge. Then I will merge upstream `main` into this branch, run the quick gate and any reached heavy lanes, and post the results on the refreshed head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 3572ca334b536329a70c6536ce55d13ce9dfd6ff -->
Needs changes before merge.

This is a re-review of the same head `3572ca334` after the author's comment of 2026-11-22T18:39Z. That comment added screenshots to the PR body and retargeted the PR to `main`. This review checks each earlier finding again. It was built locally; no runner run.

### Earlier findings

| # | Finding | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Refresh the stack after #3353 and #3387 merge | **Not met.** #3353 merged at `f2a03d947`. The trial merge with `upstream/main` absorbs the stale commit `59b42c727` cleanly: the merged tree is the same as `upstream/main` in `crates/motion/`, `crates/app/src/operation/`, `crates/app/src/project/` and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. But #3387 is still open (`needs-rework`, `conflicts`). This branch carries its old commit `6e2d7d8f0`, not its current head `e44df8e28`. The two differ in 5 files (`mill2d_page.rs`, `pass_start_row.rs`, `tests/pass_start.rs`, `docs/decisions/3356-face-pass-start.md`, `operations-2d.md`; +40/-7 lines). If this PR merges now, it puts an old and unreviewed version of the Face change for #3356 on `main`. |
| 2 | Before/after screenshots in the PR body | **Met.** The four images (Face before and after, Slot before and after) are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch at `a86a98586`, folder `3401/`. The PR branch holds no image file. |
| 3 | Heavy-lane result on the refreshed P2 head | **Not met.** No heavy record names this head. The diff reaches `crates/app/src`, so `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` selects 210 steps. Not run - owed: the head is blocked by item 1, and a refresh makes a new head. |

### Local results, trial merge with `upstream/main` (`5346bd7ac`)

`HEAD^1` = `3572ca334b536329a70c6536ce55d13ce9dfd6ff`. The merge is clean. The effective diff against `upstream/main` is 11 files, +221/-2: the Face change (from #3387) and the Slot change.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp` | 24 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test face_pass_start` | 1 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` | 1470 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Heavy lanes | Not run - owed (210 steps; blocked head) |

#### Mutations

None on this round. The head did not change since the earlier review, and that review ran two mutations on the Slot guards (both red, then green). After the merge, the effective diff changes no posted G-code, no gouge or collision check, no stock simulation and no geometry. This is not a safety-tier review.

#### Extra suites run

- No file under `testdata/` and no importer file changed. No extra fixture or importer suites apply.

### Requested before merge

1. **Wait for #3387, then refresh (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/pass_start_row.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs`, `docs/decisions/3356-face-pass-start.md`):** Let #3387 merge first. Then merge `upstream/main` into this branch, so that the diff holds only the Slot commit. Run the quick gate again on the new head.
2. **Heavy lanes on the refreshed head:** If the refreshed Slot diff still reaches a heavy lane, run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` and record the green result in the PR body.

### Notes (not blocking, unchanged)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs` repeats the Slot reason as a literal string. It could import `SLOT_NO_PASS_ORDER`.
- The guide uses `centreline`; the code uses `centerline`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
This PR is a draft again. The branch conflicts with main in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs`. The branch takes a merge of main, then the gate runs again on the new head.

The branch has a merge of `main` at `bd2b774a8`. The new head is `a696d05f4`. The merge class is DELTA: I resolved one conflict by hand.

**Conflict.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs`. Both sides added tests at the same place. I kept the Slot test, main's newer Adaptive2D test and main's pass-start status-line test. I dropped the obsolete "Adaptive2D has no pass-start row yet" test because #3355 made its assertion false. The conflict had no Slot logic and no safety rule.

**Readings.**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: 32 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. Wall time 6.5 min, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`, no sccache.
- `slot_refuses_a_pass_start_with_its_reason_without_editing_the_job` (`camcraft-app`, `mcp`): pass.
- `the_slot_passes_tab_locks_auto_and_names_the_continuous_pass` (`camcraft-ui`, lib): pass.
- `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: pass.

heavy not run - owed to the cut. This change is UI and diagnostics. It stores no Slot field and it does not change the planner.

The PR body now shows the merge and these readings. It keeps the before/after screenshots and the `Changelog:` line.

The PR is ready for a re-review on head `a696d05f4`.

Merge. Class: DELTA (refresh merged main `bd2b774a8` into the reviewed head `3572ca334`; the remerge-diff is one keep-both UI test union, no logic). Review: pullrequestreview-6014804647 at `a696d05f4`, with the quick gate on that exact head (32 steps, 0 failed) and the light lane green. Heavy not run - owed to the cut (#3558). Nothing is pushed after this flag.

Coordinator: the merge route is the coordinator's. Another session merged this PR with no trial merge here. The PR changes the planning of the Slot toolpath (Pass starts). The post-merge run of 60b19abe8 is its check; a red step there is worked as a red `main`.
